name: treg
description: Searches and calls 4,100+ paid data APIs (SEO, backlinks, work emails, company data, social posts, ads) through one token and MCP server, billed per call from a prepaid balance.

skills.name: Catalog search
skills.description: Searches the catalog by the job to be done and returns the tools that do it, with prices.

skills.name: Tool details
skills.description: Shows a tool's parameters, price and measured reliability, with a ready call line.

skills.name: Call a tool
skills.description: Calls a catalog tool or a team-registered API, with the credential injected on the server.

skills.name: Request a tool
skills.description: Files a request for a job the catalog has no tool for yet.
